questions.question: In which manga chapter does Biting Twist first appear?
questions.subject: Biting Twist

answer.item: Biting Twist is an attack that utilizes Savage Jaw Strike. With both of their hands, the user strikes the target in a twisting motion with great force, capable of rendering said target unconscious.

questions.question: How did Yuka use Biting Twist against a curse user?
questions.subject: Biting Twist

answer.item: While battling a curse user, Yuka dealt the finishing blow to the man with Biting Twist, briefly rendering him unconscious.

questions.question: How did Yuka use Biting Twist against Masaki Takeda?
questions.subject: Biting Twist

answer.item: She later used the technique as her opening surprise attack against Masaki Takeda.
After performing the hand sign to summon the Divine Dogs, the user draws the shikigamis' jaw strength into their hands, causing their fingernails to grow long and become very sharp.
